API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIForwarding Control PolicyProxy Gateway Resource Get Gateways
Proxy Gateway Resource Get Gateways
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/proxyGateways

Retrieves the proxy gateway information. To learn more, see About Gateways for Proxies.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

Unique identifier for the proxy

name
string

Name of the proxy. You can sort this column.

type
string

Proxy type

Possible values: [PROXYCHAIN, ZIA, ECSELF]

primaryProxy
object
secondaryProxy
object
description
string

Additional notes or information about the gateway. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

lastModifiedBy
object
lastModifiedTime
int32

Timestamp when the gateway was last modified. This is a read-only field. This field is not applicable to the Lite API.

failClosed
boolean

Indicates whether fail close is enabled to drop the traffic or disabled to allow the traffic when both primary and secondary proxies defined in this gateway are unreachable.

]
